help.title: Delivery, returns and help
help.metaDescription: Delivery times and costs by zone, returns and answers to common questions.
help.freeFrom: Delivery is free on orders from {amount}, whatever the zone.
help.deliveryNote: We do not deliver on Sundays. The courier calls before coming: give a number where you can be reached and, if possible, a landmark near your home.
help.r1text: Write to {email} with your order number.
help.r2text: Unused, in its original packaging. We agree with you on how to collect it.
help.r3text: By Mobile Money, within 5 working days after we receive the item.
help.q1: Can I order without creating an account?
help.a1: Yes. An email address and a phone number are enough. An account also lets you track your orders and save your address.
help.q2: How do I use a promo code?
help.a2: Enter it in the cart before checkout. The discount shows at once in the summary. One code per order.
help.q3: An item is sold out, will it come back?
help.a3: Most of the time, yes. Add it to your favourites to find it on your next visit.
help.q4: Which payment methods do you accept?
help.a4: MVola, Orange Money and Airtel Money: after ordering, you send the amount to the number shown, then copy the transaction reference. You can also pay cash on delivery.
help.a5: Write to {email}. We answer Monday to Saturday.

about.metaDescription: Alarobia means Wednesday: an online shop for everyday things, delivered anywhere in Madagascar.
about.title: Alarobia means Wednesday.
about.lead: In many towns of the island, the market is named after its day. People come back every week for what the household needs. {name} does the same online, every day except Sunday.
about.week: The days of the week in Malagasy
about.p1text: Tableware, baskets, groceries, care products, small appliances: what is really used at home, not showpieces.
about.p2text: The price shown is the price paid. Delivery cost and day are given before you order, zone by zone.
about.p3text: With MVola, Orange Money or Airtel Money, or in cash when the parcel arrives.

legal.title: Legal notice and terms
legal.notice: Template to be reviewed and completed by a legal professional before any commercial launch.
legal.s1text: {name}. Company name, legal form, registered address, registration number and publication director: to be completed before launch.
legal.s2text: Name and address of the host: to be completed before launch.
legal.s3text: Prices include all taxes and exclude delivery. The sale is concluded when the order is confirmed. You may return an unused item within 30 days of receiving it.
legal.s4text: The information collected is used only to process your orders and, if you agreed, to send our newsletter. You may ask to access, correct or delete your data at {email}.
legal.s5text: This site only uses strictly necessary cookies: your session, your cart and your language. No advertising tracker is set.
